name: How long does sewer line repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does sewer line repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of sewer line repair depends on the complexity and scope of the work. Simple repairs, such as clearing a common clog, might take a few hours. More involved repairs, like trenchless pipe lining, can often be completed within a day or two. Traditional excavation and replacement of a significant section of pipe might take several days, especially if permits or extensive site work are required. Your plumbing professional can provide a more precise timeline after diagnosing the issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sewer line repair times vary from a few hours for simple clogs to several days for extensive replacements, depending on the complexity.
